description: This file contains helper methods for extracting tokens and IDs from HTML page content in functional tests for the web application, including regex-based parsing logic.

classes.name: WebPageHelpers
classes.description: A static class providing helper methods for parsing HTML content in functional web tests.

methods.name: GetRequestVerificationToken
methods.description: Extracts the request verification token value from input HTML string.

methods.name: GetId
methods.description: Extracts the ID value from input HTML for the first item.

methods.name: RegexSearch
methods.description: Performs regex matching on input string using provided pattern and returns the last captured group.
